breakdown.description: The formulation is introduced as displacement-based compressible neo-Hookean, but later switches to a mixed incompressible J = 1 constraint.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification consistently uses a displacement-only compressible neo-Hookean formulation throughout. It defines F = I + grad(u), C = F^T*F, J = det(F), and a compressible neo-Hookean strain energy density psi = (mu/2)*(tr(C)-3) - mu*ln(J) + (lmbda/2)*(ln(J))^2. There is no mention of a mixed displacement-pressure formulation or an incompressibility constraint J = 1. This correctly resolves the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt contradictorily introduced a mixed incompressible formulation after describing a displacement-based compressible problem.
